The averaged load cells' Rated Output in mV/V

AttributeList.Text: CalFree is a method of analog scale adjustment without using test weights. It takes the factory calibrated load cell Rated Output (mV/ Vexc.) and user defined scale capacity to build a linear loading curve. This method is usually applied to huge capacity scales in which calibration with test weights or other material is not feasible at all.

CalFree adjustment steps:
1. Switch on Input bit Start
2. Write in (a) Scale Capacity (Index 0x401A), (b) Scale unit (Index 0x401C, Decimal 0 - gram; Decimal 1 - KG; Decimal 2 - Pounds) and (c) Load Cells' averaged Rated Output (Index 0x401D, in mV/V)
3. Start CalFree adjustment (Index 0x401A)
4. Continuously read in adjustment status (Index 0x4007)
5. Output bit Done will be turned ON after completion of the process
